summary: "What actually uses this?" across open scenes and the project, before you rename or delete it.
overview: Drag in an asset or a scene object and search either or both: open scenes, which walks every GameObject and inspects each component, and the project, which searches asset files. The question to ask before a rename, a delete or a refactor.
whereToFind: Toolkit ▸ Find References (also on the Assets context menu)
useCases: Checking whether an asset is safe to delete.
Finding every prefab that uses a material before changing it.
Tracking down which scene object holds a reference you cannot find.

gotchas.title: Only OPEN scenes are searched for scene references
gotchas.body: A reference in an unopened scene will not be found. "No references" means none in what is currently loaded, plus the project search.

gotchas.title: A project search reads asset files, so it is not instant
gotchas.body: On a large project this takes a moment. It is still much faster than finding out the hard way.
